digest.component_or_area: development process audit and decision-history review
propositions: Six process improvement recommendations from the bleakish-stational-cob audit require evaluation against prior decisions, janitor work, and implementation outcomes to determine whether they should be reaffirmed, refined, reconsidered, or deferred.
Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was implemented as optional fail-open creation but shows only 1.1% coverage; the audit queried tags incorrectly and the implementation preceded the audit cutoff.

Deterministic plan preflight currently enforces P1-P11 floor based on low false-positive rates; incremental re-review is unsafe, and further extension should require recurrent mechanically-decidable failure classes with offline validation.

Completion-failure classification mixes multiple categories (code defects, unmet ACs, missing evidence, gaps, integration failures, verifier defects); historical sidecars already carry structured findings and should be classified offline before adding schema.

Risk-tiered review cannot use caused_by attribution reliably and lacks a true escaped-defect denominator; pilot risk reporting without merge enforcement and measure signals, override frequency, and defect/revert outcomes before hard enforcement.

Autonomous governance requires distinguishing author and reviewer agents/models, monitoring provider diversity and correlated failures, and testing recovery paths rather than adding mandatory human approval or rotation.
